忙碌的蚂蚁 (Chinese (Simplified)) 这本书里的蚂蚁一定会让我们的小读者们忙碌起来。这本书是我们的四本'我们身边的动物'丛书之一。 This is a Level 1 book for children who are eager to begin reading. Pratham Books goes digital to weave a whole new chapter in the realm of multilingual children's stories. Knitting together children, authors, illustrators and publishers. Folding in teachers, and translators. To create a rich fabric of openly licensed multilingual stories for the children of India and the world. Our unique online platform, StoryWeaver, is a playground where children, parents, teachers and librarians can get creative. Come, start weaving today, and help us get a book in every child's hand!

pages.originalText: 你好，我是这条队伍里的第四个。你能看到我吗？
pages.text: 你好，我是这条队伍里的第四个。你能看到我吗？

image.attributionText: Page 2: Child watching a row of ants , by Deepa Balsavar © Pratham Books, 2015. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 左，右，左，右。我们安安静静地排成一条线走。
pages.text: 左，右，左，右。我们安安静静地排成一条线走。

image.attributionText: Page 3: Girl and dog watching a row of ants , by Deepa Balsavar © Pratham Books, 2015. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 啊，我有个好主意！我去找一对轮子，就可以走得更快了！
pages.text: 啊，我有个好主意！我去找一对轮子，就可以走得更快了！

image.attributionText: Page 4: Ants on wheels , by Deepa Balsavar © Pratham Books, 2015. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 我们和其他动物不一样，我们一点也不吵闹。我们的语言是气味。
pages.text: 我们常常用气味传递消息。那就是我们的“语言”。

image.attributionText: Page 5: Ants feasting on a lollipop while a child, dog and cat wail , by Deepa Balsavar © Pratham Books, 2015. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 一种气味在说：“跟我这边走，有大餐！”
pages.text: 一种气味在说：“跟我这边走，有大餐！”

image.attributionText: Page 6: Ants marching towards a cake , by Deepa Balsavar © Pratham Books, 2015. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 另一种气味代表：“危险！别去那里！”
pages.text: 另一种气味代表：“危险！别去那里！”

image.attributionText: Page 7: Floor being wiped, ants crawling away , by Deepa Balsavar © Pratham Books, 2015. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 我喜欢蛋糕和各种甜点，就跟你一样。
pages.text: 我喜欢蛋糕和各种甜点，就跟你一样。

image.attributionText: Page 8: Ants feasting on an assortment of sweets , by Deepa Balsavar © Pratham Books, 2015. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 你想看我的肌肉工作吗？我也许看着很渺小，可是我很强壮！
pages.text: 你想看看我的力气吗？我看起来很小，可是很强壮！

image.attributionText: Page 9: Ant carrying a round, green object , by Deepa Balsavar © Pratham Books, 2015. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 就算门是关着的也没关系，我可以从最小的缝隙里钻过。
pages.text: 就算门是关着的也没关系，我可以从最小的缝隙里钻过。

image.attributionText: Page 10: Ants crawling towards a shelf filled with food , by Deepa Balsavar © Pratham Books, 2015. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 不管你信不信，我们是群居动物，成百上千个我们快乐地生活在一起。
pages.text: 不管你信不信，我们是群居动物，成百上千只蚂蚁快乐地生活在一起。

image.attributionText: Page 11: Colony of ants , by Deepa Balsavar © Pratham Books, 2015. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText:
让我们学一些新词：

小 - 大

慢 - 快

矮 - 高

瘦 - 胖

硬 - 软

吵 - 静



这里是一些反义词对子，你可以用每一对反义词造个句子吗？

比如说，蚂蚁很小，大象很大。

“像蚂蚁一样忙碌”，常常用来形容一个辛勤工作的人。
